items.statement: Current order book is roughly Rs.1,800 crore including SPML Infra and JV
items.quote: Currently we have an order book of roughly around Rs.1,800 crore, including SPML Infra and JV.

items.statement: Expect order book of Rs.1,500-2,000 crore in next 6 months from new orders
items.quote: We should have atleast Rs.1,500 to Rs.2,000 crore order book in next 6 months, but that depends on how it pans out due to the competitive bidding.

items.statement: Target FY25 closing order book of Rs.2,500-3,000 crore including old and new orders
items.quote: Old and new together.

items.statement: Q3 FY25 revenue and margins expected to be similar to Q2; Q4 may improve with new orders
items.quote: Q3 will be more or less in a similar line. Q4, there may be some business.

items.statement: Topline for FY25 expected at Q2 run-rate unless new orders received; growth from FY26
items.quote: Till we get new orders, we will be on the similar line as we are currently. Q4 will be slightly high, but the top line will be on similar lines. From next year, the top line will increase along with the bottom line as it will include new orders.

items.statement: Targeting 10-12% EBITDA margin on new bulk water orders
items.quote: We are targeting the new order at a 10-12% margin, but that finally depends upon what rate will come. Nevertheless we are targeting at 10-12%.

items.statement: Q2 FY25 EBITDA margin 13%, PAT margin 7%, at par with targeted EBITDA margins
items.quote: For Q2 FY'25, EBITDA margin and PAT margin stood at 13% and 7% respectively, which is at par with our targeted EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Raised Rs.346 crore via preferential allotment; Rs.290 crore cash, Rs.170 crore already issued, Rs.1 crore expected in 18 months
items.quote: We have successfully raised an amount of Rs.346 crore through the preferential allotment of shares and warrants out of which Rs.290 crore will be received in cash and balance through conversion of loan to NARCL as per their terms.

items.statement: Total FD Rs.280 crore as of date; expected to reach Rs.460 crore from further equity and Vivad se Vishwas proceeds
items.quote: With the aforesaid infusion of equity and warrants along with money realized from Vivad se Vishwas scheme and infusion from promoter earlier, total FD as on date stood at Rs.280 crore and from the further issue of equity and expected Vivad se amount, the total FD is expected to be around Rs 460 crore in future which will be utilized only for the business.

items.statement: Received Rs.268 crore from Vivad se Vishwas arbitration; balance Rs.26 crore expected in FY25
items.quote: With the successful settlement, | am pleased to announce that we have received a total of Rs.268 crore through arbitration from Vivad se Vishwas scheme and the balance amount of Rs26 crore is also expected within the current financial year

items.statement: Additional Rs.180 crore arbitration award expected at Supreme Court of Arunachal Pradesh in FY25
items.quote: We have that one award of roughly around Rs.180 crore, which is at the Supreme Court of Arunachal Pradesh, which we are expecting to receive in the current financial year.

items.statement: Participated in Rs.5,000 crore tenders out of Rs.11,000 crore available; L1 on Rs.1,400-1,500 crore
items.quote: Currently, the company has participated in a bid of Rs.5,000 crore orders against the total available tender of Rs 11,000 crore based on the company's criteria of bidding for the selected tender and we are expecting some orders to be received against this tender as it is finalising.

items.statement: Expect tender results from December onwards; order inflow by December or early January
items.quote: By December, the tender results will start coming. It has started coming to a few states and now it will start coming to various other states as well. ... By December or by early January, we can expect order inflow? Definitely.

items.statement: Medium-term goal of mid-teen EBITDA and 35% MHCV market share
items.quote: We are clear that we ar e not going to discount our products to win market share. Our market share wins will come on the back of product superiority, cost leadership, excellence in service delivery and our expanding reach

items.statement: H2 FY25 MHCV industry expected to be flattish to positive, no degrowth seen
items.quote: Degrowth for H2, we are not seeing. So we are seeing at a minimum, H2 should be kind of flattish, if not positive, like what ICRA is saying.

items.statement: FY25 capex target INR750-800 crores
items.quote: Our capex, we would like to stick to that INR750 crores of capex, which we have indicated earlier, INR800 crores max, which we'll be sticking to those numbers.

items.statement: H2 FY25 investments in subsidiaries estimated INR200-250 crores for HLF and up to INR500 crores for Switch/OHM
items.quote: We may have to fund, but it will not be very substantial amount. It could be around -- in my estimate, it could be around INR200 crores to INR250 crores equity inclusion, which may happen.

items.statement: Q2 FY25 EBITDA margin 11.6%, up from 10.6% in Q1 FY25 and 11.2% in Q2 FY24
items.quote: EBITDA margin for Q2 stands at 11.6%, better than 10.6% in Q1 of current year and also better than 11.2% in Q2 of last year.

items.statement: Steel price drop of ~INR2.5/kg and cost reduction initiatives each contributed ~0.5% margin improvement in Q2
items.quote: There has been a considerable softening which has happened on the prices of steel flat steel, proprietary steel, all these have gone down by about INR2.5 per kg So all these have got translated to 0.5% margin reduction.

items.statement: Fleet utilization recovered to ~95% country average in October, triggering replacement demand
items.quote: In October, if you have seen the data, recent data that was published on fleet utilization, it is already up to the level of 95% on an average in the country.

items.statement: Switch India order book of ~2,000 electric buses, targeting delivery in 15 months
items.quote: This order book of 2,000 that we have in hand, we hope that we will be able to complete in about 15 months of time.

items.statement: Non-CV businesses (defense, aftermarket, international) growing strongly; defense revenue doubled in H1 FY25
items.quote: On the defense side, you know that last year was a damn good year for us. We had more than doubled our top line on defense. And I'm happy to say, even in H1, we have almost doubled our defense top line.

items.statement: Mandatory AC cabin norms effective June 2025; cost impact marginal, will affect ~80% of new sales
items.quote: I think as far as I remember, the regulation is becoming effective from June 1st or 2nd week of next year.

items.statement: Reverse merger of Hinduja Leyland Finance with NXTDIGITAL on track, likely to conclude before end of Q1 FY26
items.quote: Reverse merger of Hinduja Leyland Finance with NXTDIGITAL is on track and we are in the process of obtaining the necessary approvals from RBI. This is likely to get concluded before end of Q1 FY '26.

items.statement: Switch India expected to achieve EBITDA breakeven in FY25, PAT breakeven with higher volumes
items.quote: As advised earlier, Switch India is expected to achieve EBITDA breakeven this fiscal.

items.statement: ICRA projects 0-3% MHCV truck growth for FY25, implying 6-10% H2 growth
items.quote: Also, if you have seen the recent ICRA report, it has projected a growth of 0% to 3% for the whole year in MHCV trucks.

items.statement: Material cost at 71.2% of revenue in Q2 FY25 vs 73.5% in Q2 FY24 and 72.2% in Q1 FY25
items.quote: Material cost as a percentage of revenue was at 71.2 % and 73.5% in Q2 last year and 72.2% in Q1 of current year.

items.statement: Q2 FY25 capex INR153 crores, cumulative H1 FY25 INR307 crores
items.quote: Capex for the quarter was INR153 crores and INR307 crores cumulatively for the year.

items.statement: Net debt reduced to INR501 crores end Q2 FY25 from INR1,295 crores end Q1 FY25
items.quote: Net debt at the end of the quarter was at INR501 crores, much lower than INR1,139 crores at end of Q2 last year and also lower than INR1,295 crores at end of Q1 of current year.

items.statement: Management plans 4-5% price increase over next two quarters to cover commodity inflation
items.quote: So there will be about 4% to 5% price increase in the next 2 quarters. So that we'll have to take, and we will do it strategically in SKUs where we haven't taken a price for some time.

items.statement: Expect to maintain stable margin profile rather than expand margins due to high commodity inflation
items.quote: So we expect to maintain margins rather than increase margins, balance inflation and make sure that we are able to keep a stable margin profile.

items.statement: Urban metros facing demand slowdown due to high housing costs and non-salaried wage stress
items.quote: The housing cost in urban and especially in metro areas is about 22% of the total CPI basket weight. And we know that Real Estate is -- the prices have gone up, the rentals have gone up, and that's creating stress for most consumers in large cities and metros.

items.statement: Rural growth at mid-to-high single digits, urban growth slower, rural growing at 2x urban pace
items.quote: The rural growths are reasonable, I would say, slightly high single-digit kind of growth. They're not the kind of growth that we've seen in the past, but there will be high single digits --Vipin Vipin Kataria: Yes. So it's -- so the rural growth at 2x of urban

items.statement: Will balance price increases and volumes carefully over next 6-9 months given inflation volatility
items.quote: In the next 6 months, 9 months, we are going to be very careful about how we treat price increases, how we route for volumes, et cetera. So we will balance it well, and we will make sure that we do the best from a volume standpoint as well.

items.statement: Three new factories operational in UP, Bihar, Tirunelveli plus Ranjangaon expansion; capacity adequate
items.quote: We've got 3 new factories, which are already in play. But UP, in the north we've never had a factory which is large and it provides us all that is required. So we had 1 plant in Uttarakhand, which was done about 12, 13 years ago. Now we've got a UP factory. We've got a new factory in Bihar in Bihta and we've got a brand-new factory in Tirunelveli. We've also expanded our factory in Ranjangaon.

items.statement: Innovation contributing ~2% of revenue from products launched in last 24 months
items.quote: Yes. So innovation, as we read the innovation, we -- any product which is launched in the last 24 months is considered as innovation, and we are running at about 2% of revenue on that.

items.statement: Palm oil inflation ~45% in Q2 FY25 due to 40% import duty and supply shortage; strategic covers mitigating impact
items.quote: just to give you an idea on palm oil, you are seeing a slight inflation in palm oil in Q2 '25. Actually, the inflation is about 45% over Q1and the reason for that is import duty of 40% and also a demand and supply situation, which is creating some kind of shortage in the countries of origin, which is Malaysia and Indonesia

items.statement: Salary cost up 45% YoY due to phantom stock revaluation from share price appreciation (INR50 cr impact in Q2)
items.quote: That's about INR50 crores.

items.statement: Route-to-Market 2.0 pilot in 25 cities covering 44 distributors and 50,000+ outlets showing encouraging results; full embedding in 12-15 months
items.quote: We have currently pilots in Q2 covering 25 cities, which is 44 distributors and more than 50,000 outlets, which are showing very encouraging results, and we plan to scale up implementation in the long term to maximize extraction.

items.statement: Direct reach expanded to 28.5 lakh outlets; rural distributors over 30,000; focus states performing 1.9x rest of India
items.quote: We are expanding direct reach. We are now at 28.5 lakh outlets that we cover directly. There is an uptick in rural distribution where we've -- our number of distributors is now over 30,000, the rural distributors. O ur focus states are performing better. They're about 1.9x what rest of India is

items.statement: Volume growth 8% in Q2 FY25; 12-month revenue growth 4.5%; operating profit INR707 cr (12% below YoY, 7% above 24-month)
items.quote: We've achieved INR4,566 crores, which is a volume -- the volume growth is almost 18%. It's -- sorry, 8%, sorry, what am I talking about? So volume growth is 8%. The 12-month growth on revenue is about 4.5% and the 24 months is also similar at 5%.

items.statement: Operating profit margin 15.5%, PBT margin 15.7%, PAT margin 11.6% in Q2 FY25
items.quote: And if you were to look at the ratios at the bottom, profit from operations is still 15.5%, profit before tax is 15.7% and profit after t ax is a very healthy 11.6

items.statement: Wheat inflation structural due to lower crop and government stocks; expecting improvement next year with better acreage and yields
items.quote: Wheat, it's a fundamental issue as far as wheat is concerned because the crop has been lower, the government is holding less stocks. And hence, the release of stocks has been lower. But it's 1 year. Now we are moving into the next year soon. And hopefully, the crops will be better because as the prices go up, more farmers start to look at that crop.

items.statement: Adjacent businesses (wafers, rusk, croissant, drinks, international) showing momentum despite base business slowdown
items.quote: Our wafer business has been doing quite well. Even our rusk business has been seeing the uptick. Croissant has been doing extremely well. Our drinks have been showing resurgence, both in our PET format as well as the Lassi, which is in the tetra pack format. And our international business, especially the Middle East, has been doing extremely well as well.

items.statement: Quick commerce and e-commerce growing well with share gains; modern trade reasonable; traditional trade slower but rural recovering
items.quote: We've been seeing very good growth as far as quick commerce and e-commerce is concerned. Even modern trade has been doing reasonably well. Although the competitive scenario there is pretty tough, but we've been doing well, and we've been gaining share in both quick commerce, e-commerce as well as modern trade. It's the traditional trade, the GT part of the business, which is growing slower current

items.statement: Maintain FY27 revenue guidance of INR17,000-18,000 crores with 2.5% EBITDA margin
items.quote: we maintain our guidance of INR17,000 crores-INR18,000 crores of revenue by FY27 with 2.5% EBITDA margin

items.statement: FY25 revenue guidance maintained at INR6,500 crores despite Q1 softness
items.quote: I guess for full year, we are sticking to our guidance of INR6,500 crores kind of revenue

items.statement: Full year FY25 EBITDA margin guidance of 2% plus maintained
items.quote: full year our EBITDA margin will be similar to what we guided for on the conference call in September 2024 which we spoke about

items.statement: Volume guidance of 1.2 million tons plus for FY25 and 2 million tons plus for FY26
items.quote: Full year we should do 1.2 million tons plus. Dharmil: And for FY26? Anubhav Gupta: For next year it should be 2 million tons plus

items.statement: Plan to spend INR100 crores in H2 FY25 and INR300-400 crores in FY26 for 10 new service centers
items.quote: This year, we may spend another INR100 crores in the second half and for the next year, the budget is to spend INR300 crores-INR400 crores to set up 10 service centers

items.statement: Target minimum 20-25 service centers operational by FY27
items.quote: once we enter in FY27, we should be operating minimum 20, 25 service centers

items.statement: Service centers to contribute 40-50% of revenue in next 2 years
items.quote: We expect service centers to contribute 40%, 50% to our revenue in the next 2 years

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin impacted by 1% due to INR17-18 crores inventory loss from 15% steel price crash
items.quote: it eroded almost 1% of our EBITDA

items.statement: Expect margin recovery to 2-2.5% in coming quarters as steel prices stabilize
items.quote: the margin will recover to 2-2.5% in the coming quarters despite some heavy ads spend what we are doing to create the brand

items.statement: Steel prices crashed 15% (INR7,500/ton) from July to September causing inventory losses despite 8-day inventory
items.quote: Steel prices came down by INR7,500 per ton from July to September, which is almost 15% crash

items.statement: Monthly sales volume target of 120,000 tons for rest of FY25, 160,000 tons/month for FY26, 250,000 tons/month for FY27
items.quote: we are doing 120,000 ton per month easily now, which we shall try to maintain for the rest of the financial year. And next year we will take it up to 160,000 tons per month, which is FY26. And eventually we shall move towards 250,000 tons per month in FY27

items.statement: Launching solar profile structures (40,000 ton/month market, INR250 crores) and PEB construction products (purlins, deck sheeting) in service centers by Dec-Jan
items.quote: We shall start this product in December or January, over the next 1 to 2 months

items.statement: Net working capital to remain negative until 7-8 service centers fully operational and volume reaches 200,000-250,000 tons/month
items.quote: for the next few quarters, the working capital should remain in the negative zone until the business gets fully scaled up

items.statement: Zinc business still in learning phase, expect revenue clarity by next quarter
items.quote: by next quarter, we should be able to give you some clarity about the revenue guidance from the zinc as a product

items.statement: No related party deals with SG Transport or SG Finserve; logistics fully outsourced, supply chain funding optional for customers
items.quote: No, all are independent companies. No, there is no related party or deals among the group companies

items.statement: Internal goal to hit ₹100 crore AUM, pushing for more
items.quote: In terms of growth expectations, I would conservatively say our goal is to hit ₹100 crore internally. We're pushing for more, but ₹100 crore is definitely achievable.

items.statement: Moved into new office reflecting growth ambitions
items.quote: We recently moved into a new office! Our previous office was small and cozy but served us well. With our growth, we wanted a space that reflected our ambitions.

items.statement: ₹66 crores in sanctions from lenders like ICICI, RBL, AU Small Finance
items.quote: We currently have about ₹66 crores in sanctions from lenders like ICICI, RBL, AU Small Finance, and others.

items.statement: Average ROI charged to retail customers is 33%
items.quote: 33% is the ROI that we end up charging —the average ROI charged to the retail customers who borrow from us.

items.statement: Co-lending ROI on capital provided ranges between 17% to 18%
items.quote: The ROI on the capital we provide, which can range between 17% to 18%.

items.statement: Expect average loan tenure to nearly double to 12 months and ticket size to ₹100,000
items.quote: Moving forward, we expect both these numbers to nearly double, with tenures closer to 12 months and ticket sizes around ₹100,000.

items.statement: 30% to 40% of book with lenders focusing on audiences with detailed insights
items.quote: Even today, around 30% to 40% of our book is with lenders focusing on audiences for whom they have detailed insights, rather than just engaging in standard personal lending.

items.statement: GNPA ratio at 0.7%, significantly below 2% target and among top 5% in industry
items.quote: We target a GNPA ratio below 2%, but right now, it's significantly below that, at 0.7%, which is among the top 5% in the industry.

items.statement: Secured ₹66 crores in sanctions against initial ₹50 crore target, optimistic figure will increase
items.quote: We've been fortunate enough to secure about ₹70 crores in sanctions—₹66 crores, to be precise—and we are optimistic that this figure will increase further.

items.statement: Launched AI tool Senti for sentiment analysis on call recordings
items.quote: We've launched an exciting AI tool, Senti, for sentiment analysis on call recordings. Senti transcribes call recordings and flags any negative sentiment.

items.statement: Hiring high-quality talent to grow team over next 12-24 months from current 28-30 people
items.quote: We have around 28 to 30 people on our team, but we're looking for high-quality talent to help us grow over the next 12-24 months.

items.statement: Regulator halted lending at major NBFCs due to aggressive pricing and excessive borrower leveraging
items.quote: The regulator has halted lending at three or four major NBFCs, including DMI and Navi, which are prominent in the digital lending space.

items.statement: Co-lending processes expected to come together within next quarter
items.quote: I see all these processes coming together within the next quarter.

items.statement: Partners launching use-case-specific products in EV and healthcare sectors
items.quote: They are also launching more use-case-specific products, which are not yet public, such as offerings in the EV or healthcare sectors.

items.statement: Model robustness requires 10-15 years; 8 years of digital lending experience so far
items.quote: I would say that, like I mentioned, it will take around 15 years for anyone to fully understand all the cycles and nuances of this space.

items.statement: Projecting highest ever sales and profitability in FY25 with strong Q3 and Q4
items.quote: we a re confident and are projecting a very strong Q3 and Q4, allowing us to record our highest ever sales and the highest ever profitability and cash generation in this financial year

items.statement: Targeting 7% PBT margin over 2-3 year timeframe as higher margin revenue scales
items.quote: So, over a 2-3 year timeframe, I think internally we have a more aggressive target, I think the 7% PBT is what our plan calls for

items.statement: Expecting 200-300 basis point margin improvement over next few years
items.quote: I think at least a 200 basis point, 300 basis point improvement over the next few years is definitely what we are targeting

items.statement: Adding green plant capacity in India and US for PEB with timeline of about a year
items.quote: In pre-engineered buildings, in India and the US , we are adding green plant capacity. We will be looking at another plant in the West of India

items.statement: Strong order books across PEB India, PEB US, process equipment, engineering services, tubes and hydraulics
items.quote: Our growth drivers continue to be PEB India, Ascent, which is US PEB business, process equipment, engineering services, tubes, and hydraulics

items.statement: Exiting 7-8 low margin revenue streams worth ~Rs. 1,000 crores, low margin business now ~30% of revenue
items.quote: So, there is almost, I would say, 7-8 revenue streams which have been removed. So, the impact of that is a reduction in an overall revenue of the company

items.statement: US metal buildings operating margins 28-32%, insulated from raw material price movements
items.quote: We get upwards of 28%, close to 32% on our US order books in metal buildings. What is there right now is quite strong

items.statement: Targeting interest cost at 3.75% of revenue for next year
items.quote: Yes, 3.75% is the next year is what we would like to tell you too

items.statement: Raebareli plant operational, adding 25-30% PEB capacity (~Rs. 300 crores revenue potential)
items.quote: So, the commissioning of the Raebareli plant effectively increases the production capacity by about 25%-30%. Due to a combination of factors, our actual revenue growth in PEB for this quarter is projected to be higher than that

items.statement: Expecting sustained double digit revenue growth driven by market share gains in large addressable markets
items.quote: Our plan is obviously sustained double digit growth. Even this year you would have seen a little less muted growth is because of the exit of the old revenue streams

items.statement: EBITDA already above 10% sustainably for last 2-3 quarters, expect further expansion from operating leverage
items.quote: So, we are already above 10% EBITDA, not 8, 9, we are about 10. And that has sustainably been the case for the last 2-3 quarters

items.statement: Debt-equity at 0.76, not expected to exceed 0.8, over 80% debt is working capital non-cash
items.quote: I think we are right now at 0.7, debt equity 0.76. So, we don't anticipate it ever growing above 0.8 for example

items.statement: Engineering services revenue at Rs. 60-70 crores with high margins, targeting quick scaling
items.quote: Currently that's at about Rs. 60, Rs. 70 crores, we expect that to grow quite well. It is one of the verticals we intend to grow quite quickly

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA expected to be ₹1,000-1,050 crores, similar to last year
items.quote: this year is expected to remain broadly similar to last year, roughly ₹1,000 crores to ₹1,050 crores kind of EBITDA given the challenges that we are going through

items.statement: Targeting FY28 EBITDA of ₹1,800-2,200 crores driven by volume growth, operating leverage and cost optimisation
items.quote: from FY '28 timeframe, I think we are targeting somewhere in the range of ₹1,800 crores to ₹2,200 crores kind of EBITDA, predominantly driven by consistent volume growth over three years because of our increased capacities

items.statement: FY25 capex moderated to ₹1,300-1,500 crores from earlier estimate of ₹1,500-1,800 crores
items.quote: I think the Capex plan has been optimised and moderated. So this year is expected to be in the range of ₹1,300 crores to ₹1,500 crores versus earlier estimate of ₹1,500 crores to ₹1,800 crores

items.statement: FY26 capex estimated around ₹1,000 crores, significantly lower than FY25
items.quote: the Capex for FY '26 is also estimated to be around ₹1,000 crores. It's a part of zone 4 and the maintenance Capex, but significantly lower than FY '25

items.statement: Cost optimisation initiatives targeting ₹150-200 crores EBITDA improvement in near term
items.quote: all of that in near-term should give us the benefit of ₹150-200 crores of EBITDA. The detailed initiatives are in the play and already under execution

items.statement: Volume and margin ramp-up in expanded capacity chains could add ₹350-550 crores EBITDA over next 2-3 years
items.quote: Especially in the areas where we have expanded capacity there's almost upside potential possible of ₹350 crores to ₹550 crores on EBITDA terms

items.statement: Capex-led growth from Zone 4 and UPL JV expected to deliver ₹300-450 crores EBITDA by FY28
items.quote: Capex-led growth, part of which, we had sort of announced in the previous calls, which will start delivering ₹300 crores to ₹450 crores, in the kind of timeframe that we're talking about FY '25 to FY '28

items.statement: Non-energy volumes grew 22% YoY in Q2 across dyes, pigments, polymer additives; agrochemicals showing green shoots
items.quote: On non-energy business, both on Y-o-Y basis and Q-o-Q basis, there is healthy volume growth. We're talking about almost 22% volume growth on a Y-o-Y basis

items.statement: MMA volumes dropped 36% QoQ in Q2 due to steep decline in gasoline-naphtha and gasoline-crude cracks
items.quote: In Q2, on a Q-o-Q basis, there was a 36% drop on the volumes for the energy business, specifically MMA. And that was linked to a steep drop in refining margins

items.statement: MMA volume recovery expected in Q3 vs Q2, but bottoming out uncertain due to refinery crack volatility
items.quote: it is fair to say that October or Q3 numbers for MMA will look better than the Q2. But using the term bottoming out, I think is sort of stretching it

items.statement: MMA capacity expanded to ~200 KTPA with ability to expand further via minor investment; bulk shipment capability established
items.quote: we've completed our expansion, our capacity is now roughly in the range of 200KTPA and we can expand it even further with a very minor investment

items.statement: Targeting MMA customer diversification from Middle East to US, Europe, Singapore; aiming to scale from 2-3 to 15-20 refineries in 2-3 years
items.quote: We were Middle East heavy for exports. Now we are targeting customers in U.S., Europe, Singapore and as well as other refineries globally

items.statement: Chinese overcapacity keeping margins under pressure across agrochemicals and fluorination chains; pricing pressure expected to persist
items.quote: pricing pressures are expected to persist, because the overcapacity levels in China are quite significant across many of these products

items.statement: Targeting debt-to-EBITDA below 2.5x and ROCE above 15% over three-year outlook
items.quote: We're saying that we target less than 2.5x of debt-to-EBITDA, ROCE of greater than 15% and EBITDA in the range of ₹1,800-2,200 crores

items.statement: Board approved second phase of renewable power; by end of 2026 over 70% of power from renewable sources
items.quote: In this todays Board Meeting, we just approved second phase, which means by the end of 2026, we will have further savings from renewable power. And compared to our total external power purchase by that time more than 70% of our power will come from renewable source

items.statement: Management forecasts EBITDA of ₹1,800 crores to ₹2,200 crores for FY28 as realistic in current market conditions.
items.quote: the numbers that we are currently forecasting as a potential guidance ₹1,800 crores to ₹2,200 crores are very realistic in current market conditions.

items.statement: Current year Capex guided at ₹1,300 crores to ₹1,500 crores; next year Capex at ₹1,000 crores including maintenance and Zone 4.
items.quote: I think the current year Capex will be in the range of ₹1,300 crores to ₹1,500 crores and the next year Capex in the range of ₹1,000 crores, which is a combination of maintenance as well as partly for zone 4.

items.statement: Incremental Capex for current and next year combined is ₹2,300 crores to ₹2,500 crores; excluding maintenance, ₹2,000 crores to ₹2,300 crores.
items.quote: So from an incremental Capex point of view, this year plus next year put together. We are talking about ₹2,300 crores to ₹2,500 crores. If I take out the maintenance Capex out of it, then it's going to be in the range of ₹2,000 crores to ₹2,300 crores.

items.statement: Management targets >15% ROCE and debt-to-EBITDA below 2.5x in next 2-3 years; current debt-to-EBITDA ~3.3x.
items.quote: We want to go to more than 15% ROCE levels. We want to achieve less than 2.5x debt-to-EBITDA and that's the path on which we are on.

items.statement: Pricing pressure has bottomed out for most products; only marginal improvement baked into FY25-28 guidance.
items.quote: I would say very marginal improvement we have baked in, not a significant one.

items.statement: MMA demand linked to gasoline-naphtha delta and octane premium, not absolute gasoline volumes; margins compressed QoQ.
items.quote: The product is linked to the margins available for gasoline and the delta between naphtha and gasoline. And those two numbers we showed there is a significant compression on both these two numbers on a QoQ basis.

items.statement: H1 FY25 sales INR467.1 cr, up 22% YoY; EBITDA INR78.6 cr; operating EBITDA INR66.8 cr, up 39% YoY
items.quote: For the first half of financial year '24, our sales totalled at INR467.1 crores, reflecting a 22% increase over the first half of financial year '24.

items.statement: Next 1-2 years growth can be supported without new capex; current capex adds ~15-20% overall capacity
items.quote: But in terms of the growth, we have talked about that for the next year, couple of years, we don't need a capex to fund that. This capex should be sufficient to supply to that growth.

items.statement: Small capacity enhancement project commissioned ahead of schedule; validation batches done; will contribute to sales in coming months
items.quote: I'm pleased to share that our small -capacity enhancement project has been commissioned ahead of schedule. We have already completed validation batches, and this additional capacity will start contributing to sales in the coming months.

items.statement: Enmetazobactam sales started in EU; initial numbers insignificant; US launch timing uncertain; India launch last week of Sep with Cipla
items.quote: I'm pleased to report that our Enmetazobactam sales have officially begun in the EU market. While the initial numbers are insignificant as the sales started just recently, we are encouraged by this initial progress.

items.statement: H1 FY25 operating EBITDA INR66.8 cr, up 39% YoY; Q2 FY25 EBITDA INR37.5 cr on sales INR222.7 cr
items.quote: Our overall EBITDA for the first half of '25 was INR78.6 crores, making a significant increase from INR54.7 crores in the first half of last year.

items.statement: Enmetazobactam India pricing ~10-15% above standard therapies; Europe per-patient price unknown; US treatment cost ~INR1 cr
items.quote: Similar to other molecules, we maybe 10%, 15% higher than other standard products that are used for similar kind of therapies.

items.statement: Regulated:emerging market split 40:60; top 3 molecules remain largest; niche products growing faster but small base
items.quote: The split remains similar, 40-60, regulated 40% emerging ,60%.

items.statement: Oral:sterile split 70:30; domestic sales ~20% of revenue; AMS branded division launched late Sep
items.quote: So oral versus sterile split remains same as our long -term guidance. So 30% sterile, 70% oral. And domestic business also remains similar at 20%.

items.statement: Ceftazidime/Avibactam US filing received FDA observations (non-serious); refiling expected this quarter; China Enmetazobactam progress unclear
items.quote: This filing has received some observations from the U.S. FDA. As per our consultant, the cited deficiencies were not of the serious nature and we are no w generating data to address these points promptly. We are currently working to remove the noted efficiencies and expect to be refile within this quarter

items.statement: PLI payout schedule for 7ACA only verbal assurances; no formal extension letter received
items.quote: But what we have understood is nobody has received any formal letter from the government that this policy is extended, and this is the now new payout period. So there are only verbal assurances to everyone at this point of time.

items.statement: Cefiderocol long-term global sales potential $2-3 bn (US+EU+China); 100M doses theoretical potential; competition welcome due to AMR scale
items.quote: Our long-term estimate both for the lifetime sales for this product is $2 billion to $3 billion, which has U.S. and Europe and China combined.

items.statement: Dhanuka Agri (subsidiary) H1 sales INR275 cr; FY25 annual ~5% growth expected; EBITDA margins single-digit
items.quote: In the first 6 months, our sale was INR275 crores.

items.statement: Last FDA inspection July 2019; next inspection expected anytime; company ready
items.quote: So last FDA infection was in July 2019. We are expecting them anytime, and we are ready for them to come, although we don't have any information from them as yet when are they going to come.

items.statement: Ceftaroline seeking US partner; Cefovecin engineering batches soon
items.quote: Ceftaroline, we are still looking for a partner for the US market.

items.statement: Current order book stands at Rs 827 Crores, 3x FY24 revenue, with defense segment at Rs 727 Crores (88%).
items.quote: Our current order book stands at Rs 827 Crores forming 3x of FY 2024 revenue.

items.statement: Revenue guidance for FY25 is Rs 450-500 Crores; expects 15-20% growth in FY26.
items.quote: The current financial year, we are expecting something between Rs 450 Crores to Rs 500 Crores. In the next year, we expect at least an increase of another 15% -- 15%, 20%.

items.statement: Construction of new RDX/HMX plant at Katepally started; expects trial production by end of FY25 and contribution from FY26.
items.quote: the construction of the new larger plant for RDX and HMX at Katepally has started and we expect installation and direction of the project to be completed in the first quarter of next financial year.

items.statement: Odisha defense explosives plant received in-principal approval; land finalization expected by end of month; expansion in 3 phases.
items.quote: company has received the letter from the Industrial Promotion & Investment Corporation of Odisha Limited, IPICOL, informing the state -level single- window clearance authority through an in -principal approval for setting up defense explosives, raw materials and ammunition plant in 3 phases at Rayagada district

items.statement: Operating margin 18% in Q2 FY25 and 18.1% in H1 FY25; full-year margins expected to remain at same percentages as product mix stable.
items.quote: Same percentages will continue because the product mix will remain same unless there is a -- there will be a shift in quarter-to-quarter.

items.statement: Provision of Rs 5 Crores made for potential liquidated damages on chaffs/flares order due to import delays; hopeful of waiver.
items.quote: we have made a provision of Rs 5 Crores towards that.

items.statement: Expects order book to be maintained between Rs 800-900 Crores over next 2 years; visibility of projects suggests bigger order book ahead.
items.quote: Yes, between Rs 800 Crores to Rs 900 Crores, it will be there.

items.statement: Export orders constitute ~25% of current order book; flares 100% indigenous, chaffs payloads 50% imported.
items.quote: around 25% of the current orders are export. That is what we are exporting to.

items.statement: LD provision made due to geopolitical logistics delays affecting imported chaff payloads; domestic production now meeting requirements.
items.quote: logistics have affected some of the imported components and payloads coming. So there were delays in that. So we have accounted -- provided for the delays and the late delivery charges.

items.statement: Nipun mines supply in batches to complete in FY25; 40mm HEAP/HEDP ammunition development completed, expects production and supplies to start in FY25.
items.quote: we are currently supplying Nipun mines in batches which are expected to complete in financial year 2025.

items.statement: R&D expenditure around 1-2% of revenue; conducted at plant/pilot scale, not separate lab.
items.quote: around the -- between 1% - 2% goes towards R&D expenditure, which appears in the R&D expenditure.

items.statement: Urban demand under pressure while rural demand continues gradual recovery; organized trade outperforming with e-commerce and modern trade momentum
items.quote: While urban demand has been under pressure, the rural demand continues its gradual recovery. The organized trade continues to outperform expectations with both e-commerce and Modern trade channels experiencing sustained upward momentum.

items.statement: Sequential rise in commodity prices for key imports increased costs, managed through operational efficiencies, strategic sourcing, and calibrated price increases
items.quote: On the input cost side, the sequential rise in commodity prices for certain key imports led to increased costs. This was actively managed through operational efficiencies and strategic sourcing as well as calibrated price increases.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 261 basis points year-on-year, showing resilience amid rising commodity prices
items.quote: Amidst the headwind of rising commodity prices, the gross margin has remained resilient, showing its upward move of 261 basis points on a year-on-year basis, which outlines operating efficiencies and strengthening of product portfolio to absorb input prices inflation.

items.statement: Medium to long-term growth expectation of 5% to 6% for nutritional beverages category; company aims to grow faster if initiatives play out
items.quote: At an overall level, our view is over a medium to long term, 5% to 6% growth is a fair for this category, which is close to a billion as we understand. But our view is that we can grow much faster than that if all the initiatives play out.

items.statement: Acquisition of Naturell India Private Limited for approximately INR 119 crores turnover, funded by cash, expected to be EPS accretive from next year
items.quote: The transaction is proposed to be funded by cash. It is expected to be EPS accretive for Zydus Wellness from the very next year post acquisition.

items.statement: Personal Care segment grew 26% with consistent double-digit growth over last 6 quarters; Food & Nutrition segment grew 9.7% with Complan, Sweetener and Nutralite showing positive value and volume growth
items.quote: The Personal Care segment registered strong consumer demand driving a double-digit growth of 26% for the quarter and continuing its upward trajectory over the last few quarters. At the same time, Food & Nutrition segment also posted a growth of 9.7% for the quarter. Complan, Sweetener and Nutralite showed positive value and volume growth.

items.statement: Palm oil substantial increase is a concern for Nutralite and food service as it becomes harder to pass on in price-sensitive market
items.quote: And the other impact I'm a little worried about for future is the palm oil substantial increase because for Nutralite and food service becomes harder to pass on. It may give us growth, but it just becomes that much harder to deal with the market because it's quite price sensitive.

items.statement: International business targeting doubling every 3 years with innovations relevant to focus markets; Sugar Free D'lite accepted across consumer segments and geographies beyond Indian diaspora
items.quote: We are looking at doubling every 3 years kind of growth and we are looking at being -- doing innovations, which are relevant to each of the focus markets.

items.statement: Gross margin expansion expected to continue for next 1-2 quarters; balanced approach of growth investment and profitability improvement
items.quote: So one year is a little hard to predict at this stage. But in, I would say, next 1 or 2 quarters, we still believe there is room for us to keep pushing it, and that's really what we are working here.

items.statement: Complan VieMax launched at INR 900 for 400g jar targeting adult nutrition via healthcare professional route; no advertising planned initially
items.quote: And our pricing is about INR900 for 1 jar of 400 grams, which is in sync with a similar high-quality products that adult nutrition has. We will focus in the top states, which are on adult nutrition and Complan, which is largely around East, South and part of North where we will use the HCP route, healthcare professionals route to promote our products. We are not planning to launch any advertising.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY25 revenue growth target of 14% to 17% with operating leverage and projected mid-teen revenue growth in coming years
items.quote: We reaffirm our FY '25 revenue growth target of 14% to 17%, with operating leverage and project mid-teen revenue growth in the coming years with decent operating leverage.

items.statement: Maintained strong gross margins at 63.5% in Q2 FY25 supported by strategic pricing and favourable product mix
items.quote: Consistent with our guidance, we maintained strong gross margins at 63.5%, supported by strategic pricing and favourable product mix.

items.statement: EBITDA margin declined to 8.7% in Q2 FY25 from 9.5% YoY due to planned investments in digital marketing and airtime costs
items.quote: EBITDA margins came in at 8.7% of revenue compared to 9.5% for the same period last year.

items.statement: Expect content & broadcasting expenses to reach 18% of revenue for full FY25, down from 19.4% in Q2
items.quote: Sequentially, content & broadcasting expenses as a share of revenue fell to 19.4% in Q2 from 20.6% in Q1 and we expect this to reach 18% of revenue for full financial year.

items.statement: Digital revenue grew 11.8% YoY to INR294 crores, contributing 39% of total B2C sales in Q2 FY25
items.quote: For Q2, TV revenue reached INR456 crores, while digital revenue totalling INR294 crores. TV revenue grew by 12.3% year-over-year. And digital revenue increased by 11.8% year-over-year with digital contributing 39% of total B2C sales.

items.statement: US revenue declined 1.6% YoY in Q2 due to election and Olympics distraction; expect demand pickup in upcoming holiday season
items.quote: The US revenue declined 1.6% year-over-year in the September quarter affected by increased attention on the election activities and Olympics. With consumer confidence improving and the elections now behind us, we expect demand to pick up in the upcoming holiday season.

items.statement: UK revenue grew 15% YoY in Q2; expect recovery in consumer demand with improving consumer confidence, lower inflation and interest rates
items.quote: In the UK, revenue grew by 15% year-over-year, majorly contributed by Ideal World. With signs of improvement in UK economy like the consumer confidence index inching up, inflation and interest rates going down, we expect a recovery in consumer demand in the coming months.

items.statement: Confident of achieving breakeven at operating level in Germany by H2 FY25; operating losses declined 41% QoQ
items.quote: Germany continues to perform well, recording 15.3% Y-o-Y revenue growth in Q2 FY '25. Q-on-Q revenue grew by 25%, while operating losses declined substantially by 41%. We are confident of achieving breakeven at the operating level by second half of FY '25.

items.statement: Expect Ideal World to reach full cost profitability from Q3 FY25 onwards
items.quote: We expect Ideal World to reach full cost profitability from current quarter onwards, Q3 onwards.

items.statement: No major capex planned; balance sheet to continue getting lighter with potential land rezoning and sale in US
items.quote: We don't foresee much capex in coming times. So, balance sheet will continue to be lighter than we had in the past few years.

items.statement: No adverse impact expected from potential Trump tariffs as VGL is lowest cost producer with 62%+ gross margins
items.quote: We believe that we are the lowest cost producer and the tariffs would impact equally everybody. So, we don't foresee us getting impacted any adverse. In fact, with our gross margin of 62% plus our cost will be lower than other competitors because their gross margins are lower.

items.statement: Digital gross margins range 65-75% for Meta/Google products; total digital margin includes low-margin rising auction clearance sales
items.quote: Gross margin for Meta products or certain Google products is anywhere from 65% to 75% depending on product to product.

items.statement: Unique customer base grew 51% YoY to 682,000; 6% organic growth excluding acquisitions; retention at 41% with 23 pieces per customer annually
items.quote: Our TV networks now reach 130 million households and our unique customer base has increased by 51% year-over-year approximately to 6,82,000. Even without our new acquisitions, the unit customer base grew 6% Y-o-Y. Customer retention stands solid at 41%, with an average of 23 pieces per customer annually on a trailing 12-month basis.

items.statement: Board declared interim dividend of INR1.5 per share for Q2 FY25, representing 89% payout
items.quote: The Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of INR1.5 per share for the quarter, representing 89% of payou t and implying a firm belief in our business model and strong growth prospects

items.statement: Mindful Souls achieved 10% PBT margin on trailing 12-month basis with 100,000+ unique customers; expect further profitability improvement with VGL supply chain
items.quote: Mindful Souls continue to perform well with PBT margin of 10% on a trailing 12-month basis. Mindful Souls now has a solid base of over 1,00,000 unique customers, which we aim to grow further. Leveraging VGL group's supply chain, we are further enhancing its profitability through better costs and are regularly launching new subscription boxes.

items.statement: Budget pay bad debt at ~1% of sales (INR32 crores in FY24); interest-free to customers but financed from balance sheet due to lower cost than third-party financing
items.quote: It is roughly -- this is around 1% of the cost to sales ratio and it is in line with, I think, past many years, if I'm referring the current number, that what you mentioned.

items.statement: Target to grow volumes 10-12% above industry growth rate
items.quote: So if the industry grows at 12%, let's say, that's the study or report we would -- we are -- we have set ourselves to grow 10% more than the industry benchmark.

items.statement: 30% gross margin target realistic, expected in a couple of quarters
items.quote: 30% is very much realistic. So the temporary, if you see the hold back is on the margin is -- if you see the composition of our revenue, in terms of key accounts, MSME, retail, that shift is happening.

items.statement: Gross margin improved 305 bps YoY to 26.4% in Q2 FY25
items.quote: Corresponding gross margin has improved by over 305 bps and stands at 26.4% for Q2 FY '25 as compared to 23.3% for the quarter ended September 2023.

items.statement: General price increase announced from Jan 2025, single-digit percentage expected
items.quote: The price increase expected is announced to be from the 1st of Jan. But you know India operates a financial model that is April to March. So most of the price hike is deferred with customers.

items.statement: Price hike to flow through from Q4 FY25, positive EBITDA contribution expected
items.quote: So as Ketan mentioned, the price hike would be a single-digit factor of our entire yield. It will actually flow in from next Q4, which will be Jan onwards. And we are positive about it to have a positive contribution on our EBITDA.

items.statement: Hub modernization budget INR 27-30 crores over 2 years, ~INR 10-15 crores per year
items.quote: But if you see on the number front, on the QIB also, we had taken, for hub modernization, budget allocation of INR27 crores to INR30 crores over a period of 2 years.

items.statement: Strong traction in automotive, pharmaceuticals and consumer durables verticals
items.quote: Some strong traction we saw in some verticals, which you wanted to know is in automotive, in pharmaceuticals and in consumer durables.

items.statement: Client mix: key accounts 68%, SME 14%, retail 18% in Q2 FY25
items.quote: Client mix for the quarter ended September 2024, for key accounts, SME and retail stood at 68%, 14% and 18%, respectively.

items.statement: Corporate restructuring amalgamation expected to complete by end of FY25
items.quote: So let's say, even if you take out a date of, let's say, it ta kes -- the process could take 3 to 4 months. By this end of financial year, positively, we'll be done with this entire amalgamation

items.statement: Company is debt-free with positive cash position of INR 170 crores as of September 2024
items.quote: I'd like to highlight that the company is debt-free as of September '24, with a positive cash position of INR170 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target to build up by 1% quarter-on-quarter from current 5.3% half-year run rate
items.quote: And the plan is to maintain this level for this year, quarter-on-quarter, built up by 1% more from here on, which actually gives us good overall profitability number to begin with.

items.statement: Volume growth to be in line with industry plus 10-12% incremental delta
items.quote: And from here on, as Ketan mentioned, the industry growth, let's say, our growth will be in line with the industry, which -- and on top of that, based on our mix and presence or dominance of the routes, we would be above market by 10% to 12%.

items.statement: Service levels at upward of blended 90% across all parameters in September 2024
items.quote: For September 2024, our service level was an upward of blended 90% across all parameters, which are industry leading.

items.statement: Customer loyalty ratio improved to 1.38 from 0.82 in Q1 FY25
items.quote: Today, we are at 1.38 percentage points ratio compared to 0.82 during Q1 FY '25.

items.statement: Future generic products advancing towards qualifications and regulatory approvals in US and Europe, expected to start contributing revenues from 2026 onwards
items.quote: We anticipate these products to start contributing to our revenues from 2026 onwards.

items.statement: Total capex for FY25 including Kakinada Greenfield project assumed at ₹1,000 crores, taking total to around ₹1,600 crores
items.quote: I would say including Kakinada and everything put together, another ₹1,000 crores is what we are assuming.

items.statement: Capex from next year expected to be slightly lower as Kakinada shifts to Brownfield expansion unless massive new opportunity arises
items.quote: From the next year, because it's going to be Brownfield expansion, it's going to be slightly lower than what it has been this year, unless there is a huge opportunity that we would be seeing, it would require again a massive investment.

items.statement: Contrast media projects moving through qualifications to commercial supplies with year-on-year volume increase of 20-30%
items.quote: And while commercializing, it is a long-term contract with year-on-year increase in volume. So, it's hard to say that. I would say about year-on-year, we would have a 20% to 30% increase in volume would be a fair statement.

items.statement: Material consumption stable at ~41% of sales revenue for H1 FY25, down from rising trend last year
items.quote: Material consumption remains at about 41% of the sales revenue for the first half of the current financial year.

items.statement: Generic pricing pressure across the board (Naproxen, Gabapentin, Carbidopa, Levodopa) but volume growth remains double-digit
items.quote: we are seeing pricing pressure across the board. It's not related to one segment or one therapy. We are seeing an overall pricing pressure and though volume wise, we have not lost any Divi’s volume. We have seen a volume-based growth on these products

items.statement: Raw material prices stable over past six months but cautious due to Middle East developments and crude oil fluctuations
items.quote: On procurement front, we have observed stability in raw material prices over the past six months. While the stability has been favorable, we are approaching it with caution as the market remain sensitive to developments in the Middle East and fluctuations in crude oil prices.

items.statement: Custom synthesis RFPs and onsite visits from existing and potential customers steadily rising with focus on supply chain resilience and backward integration
items.quote: The number of RFPs and onsite visits from our existing customers and potential customers has been steadily rising. With the focus on securing long term partnerships, that emphasize supply chain resilience and backward integration.

items.statement: H1 FY25 product mix: Generics 49%, Custom Synthesis 51%
items.quote: Product mix for generics to custom synthesis for the half year is 49% and 51% respectively.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis extended transit times from 45 to ~70 days and raised logistics costs; mitigating by advancing shipments 3-4 weeks and maintaining extended safety stock
items.quote: continued disruptions in red sea have impacted global shipping lanes, with increased attack on commercial vessels prompting the routing of shipments via South Africa. This change has extended our transit times from around 45 days to approximately 70 days and raised associated logistics costs.

items.statement: Unit-III Greenfield expansion (200-acre Kakinada project) phase-wise production commencement expected December 2024
items.quote: With phase-wise production activity expected to begin in December 2024, this facility will provide us with added capacity needed to support our growth and further extend our production capabilities.

items.statement: USFDA inspection at Unit-II Visakhapatnam successfully concluded in Q2 FY25
items.quote: In Q2, we have successfully concluded a USFDA inspection at our Unit-II facility in Visakhapatnam.

items.statement: Peptide capacity expanding: operating multiple 500-litre reactors for Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis, further expansion underway
items.quote: We have established infrastructure dedicated to Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS) and currently operating multiple 500-litre reactors. With the demand continuing to rise, we are now expanding our Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis facilities further.

items.statement: Continuous flow chemistry technology successfully applied at lab and pilot scale, commercial scale production expansion planned in next 1-2 years
items.quote: Divi's is set to expand its use into commercial scale production in the next one to two years.

items.statement: Gadolinium-based contrast media compounds in qualification stages, commercialization hoped in next 1-2 years
items.quote: Coming to Gadolinium compounds, we are still in qualification stages with our customers and we hope in the next one to two years, we will be commercializing on them.

items.statement: Ticagrelor generic launch expected in 2026, several other molecules coming off patent in 2027-2029
items.quote: The only one I can talk about is what I spoke last time is Ticagrelor which is coming off in 2026. But, we have several other molecules coming out in '27, '28 and '29.

items.statement: Reiterated 15%+ growth in cranes, material handling and construction equipment for FY25; agri segment 10-15% growth; overall ~15%+ with stable EBITDA margins
items.quote: Going forward, we would like to reiterate our earlier guidance of 15% -plus growth in cranes, material handling and construction equ ipment segments for the current year and expect agri segment to g row 10% to 15% during the year

items.statement: Guidance range 15-20% maintained; conservative 15%+ stated due to election and monsoon headwinds
items.quote: See, our guidance last year -- in the last quarter was 15% to 20%, and I believe it is still similar. That's why we're saying 15% -plus.

items.statement: Largest ever single defense order ~INR420 cr expected in November; 3-year execution targeting INR200 cr/year in FY26-27
items.quote: It is a INR400 crores-plus, close to about INR420 crores order. It is our single largest order. And also, obviously, the largest order we've ever received from the Army.

items.statement: Revenue capacity to reach INR5,100 cr by Q4 FY25; further INR600 cr possible with nominal capex; land acquired for future expansion
items.quote: The company currently has a revenue capacity of around INR4,500 crores, which is set to increase by an additional INR600 crores through the ongoing capacity expansion, bringing the total to over INR5,100 crores by quarter 4 of current financial year.

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 18.04% (+268 bps YoY); H1 margins highest ever at 17.9% EBITDA, 15.9% PBT, 11.9% PAT
items.quote: The operational revenues grew by 12.2% on a year -on-year basis to INR754.34 crores with an EBITDA margin of 18.04%.

items.statement: Margin expansion driven equally by product mix shift to higher tonnage cranes and lower steel prices; price hike planned Jan 1
items.quote: definitely, there is an angle of product mix, which has added to our EBITDA margins in the last quarter. And going forward, this product mix benefit will be there because higher tonnages crane, even in the pick-and-carry segment, within this segment, are gaining more traction.

items.statement: Engine emission norms shift BS III->BS V (12% cost increase) and BS IV->BS V (5-6%) from Jan 1; 60% of machines affected; price hike planned
items.quote: going fro m BS III to BS V, there will be a cost impact of around 12%, average. Machines going from BS IV to BS V from 1st January onwards, there will be 5% to 6% increase

items.statement: Pre-buying started post-Diwali ahead of Jan 1 price hike; expecting 15-20% additional sales; second half typically 55% of revenue
items.quote: It has already started happening post Diwali till 4th there were holidays. It has already started happening. The number of orders and inquiries have started increasing.

items.statement: Higher tonnage cranes (20T+) and NX-series multi-activity cranes gaining traction; patented products; market share target 70% in pick-and-carry
items.quote: it is attributable to the tonnage mix, obviously, which is shifting as a cycle, it keeps on happening every 5 years, 7 years. And now it is happening 20 -tons and above category.

items.statement: Kato Works 50-50 JV for crawler/truck/rough-terrain cranes; definitive agreements by early Q4; production in 6-8 months; revenue FY26, full steam FY27
items.quote: definitive agreements are being negotiated currently, and we are hopeful that by early quarter 4, all this process would be finished. And we would be setting up a joint venture, maybe within quarter 4 itself or early next financial year in quarter 1 FY '26.

items.statement: Electric cranes ready; awaiting CMVR notification by Nov/Dec; sales ramp from Jan 2025
items.quote: The -- see, product is already available. The only thing the regulations are missing. So again, it is expected that within November or latest by December, the notification, which has come with respect to CMVR regulations for this electric construction equipment should get notified and we can sell it and get it registered.

items.statement: Spare parts revenue ~4% of turnover; target 50-100% increase via DMS and service app; direct O&M for tower/crawler cranes
items.quote: around 4% of our turnover, sir. Sorab Agarwal: 4% of our turnove r. So I've understood your question, I'll answer it in 2 parts. We realize that the sales of our spare parts is reasonably underpenetrated in the market because over the years, a lot of spurious players and alternate parts have come up

items.statement: Land bank: 100 acres main site (supports ~INR6,500 cr); 21 acres registered, 61 acres Q4 possession, 48 acres applied in another state for exports/logistics
items.quote: at our existing main facility, which is close to about 100 acres. So after these expansions, there will be a scope of constructing more but to a limit of maybe INR500 crores to INR1,000 crores more. So let's say, from our existing piece of land, at best, we will be able to go to close to maybe around INR6,500 crores plus/minus.

items.statement: Net cash INR610 cr (INR785 cr investments vs INR140 cr debt); short-term borrowings temporary for MSME payments and land advances
items.quote: we've got investment of INR785 crores and a debt of INR140 crores, so net of INR610 crores...

items.statement: Anticipating 15-20% topline growth and 12-15% bottomline growth for FY26
items.quote: So, again, as we already indicated in the last call, I think we are anticipating around 15% to 20% growth on the topline. And bottomline, around 12% to 15%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to remain in 18-20% range for FY26
items.quote: Margin will be around 18. Right now, we are already at 18%. I think it'll be in that same range 18% to 20% depends on product mix and volume because we are increasing the volumes on high volume products.

items.statement: Backward integration CAPEX to be completed by Q4 FY25
items.quote: As I have alluded in my opening speech, I think by Q4, we will be completing the CAPEX for the vertical integration projects. So, I think we will be fully backward integrated by the end of Q4 FY25.

items.statement: Backward integration expected to increase profitability by 5-8%
items.quote: But obviously, definitely the re will be saving on the cost as well. The profitability will definitely increase by around close to around 5% to 8% to what we currently have.

items.statement: Vizag site capacity to reach 3000 KL post CAPEX
items.quote: Our volume for Vizag site will be reaching around 3000 KL.

items.statement: Vizag utilization expected to rise from 60% to 75% by FY26
items.quote: So, right now the utilization level is at around 60%. I think we are anticipating it to go up to 75%. Shaurya: By

items.statement: New products in pipeline, commercialization in 2-3 years due to patents
items.quote: So, new products are still in the pipeline phase right now. They're in the pipeline, few on the validation phase. So, they're not fully commercial yet. And these products will not be commercialized now because they have some patents associated with them. So, I think it will take 2-3 years for them to commercialize them.
